Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.

1719-2645-3430-5233.description:
Activate Boros Garrison by tapping it, adding {R}{R}{R}{W}{W}{W} due to Nyxbloom Ancient

Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.

4113-5895-6991.description:
Cast Splash Portal by tapping Donnie & April due to Splash Portal's convoke ability, blinking Donnie & April.
When Donnie & April enters, it triggers, returning Splash Portal from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4275-5003-6495-7892.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four other Elves that do not have summoning sickness.
4275-5003-6495-7892.description:
Activate at least four Elves other than Thranduil by tapping them, adding at least four in any combination of {G} and/or {U}.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Thranduil.
When Thranduil dies, Nim Deathmantle and Faces of the Past trigger.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Thranduil from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Faces of the Past trigger, untapping all Elves and Nobles.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
4275-5003-6495-7892.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

907-1479-7893.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it, Thranduil, Sindarin Liege, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

4477-4872-7370.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Greenwarden of Murasa.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Greenwarden of Murasa from exile to the battlefield.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

884-4399-4770-6626.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Ayara triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Ayara trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Ayara trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
884-4399-4770-6626.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

215-1355-7730.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Sanctum Weaver from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Sanctum Weaver by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

252-4871-7730.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature and have a way to cause that creature to die.
252-4871-7730.description:
Kill any other creature you control.

Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Omarthis.

When Omarthis dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Omarthis from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying the Radiant Lotus token's ability, targeting yourself.
Resolve both Radiant Lotus abilities, adding twelve mana of any color.
Repeat.

1362-1479-6529.description:
Play Oboro, Palace in the Clouds.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, Curse of the Restless Dead and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
In response, activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Curse of the Restless Dead trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Oboro from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Skullwinder and exiling Ephemerate.
When Skullwinder enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Skullwinder.
When Skullwinder enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1806-2060-2438-6774-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Loading Zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

851-1434-2506-7150.description:
Cast Kirol by paying {1}{R/W}{R/W}
When Kirol enters, Molten Echoes triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and another creature you control, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Molten Echoes's ability, creating two token copies of Kirol with haste.
Holding priority, activate a Kirol token by tapping both Kirol tokens, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

Repeat from step 2.

628-640-5670--5.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
628-640-5670--5.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers if it didn't have a -1/-1 counter on it, and its undying ability triggers if it didn't have a +1/+1 counter on it. Dross Harvester also triggers regardless.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the persist trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the undying trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat

When Badgermole Cub enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 3.

Draw a card.

Resolve all Horizon Chimera triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each trigger.
Resolve the first Lyla trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fetid Gargantua.
Fetid Gargantua triggers, causing you to draw two cards and lose 2 life.

2428-6822-6980.notes: With the additional Lyla trigger, you can target any creature you control to put a +1/+1 counter on that creature.

549-856-4779-6748-6757.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.

Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.

Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.

2921-4853-6810.description:

Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Thopter.
When the Thopter dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Detective's Satchel.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Magic Pot that are 1/1 Soldiers.

When the Magic Pot tokens die, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.

1479-4288-5700-5701-6664.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Sarinth Greatwurm trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Sarinth Greatwurm triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Sarinth Greatwurm triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

2428-3017-3591-6282.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2428-3017-3591-6282.description:

Resolve the Ghostly Pilferer ability.

413-6247-6249--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
413-6247-6249--5.description:

When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Olivia trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia and Doom Weaver's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Olivia trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Doom Weaver trigger, repairing it and the persist creature.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger.

The token copy of Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

721-2724-2827.description:

Pay {5}{U}{U} to turn Wormfang Manta face up.
